name: Witch Hunter: Darkslayer and Heartseeking Bolt cast in their client SpellCastTimes, hasted by Auto Shot (#11409)
contract: Darkslayer 804179, 680256-680262 and 681203 and Heartseeking Bolt 805754 and 807279-807284 are ranged-slot spells
(SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT 0x2) of family 21 with CastingTimeIndex 16 (1500 ms) for Darkslayer rank 1, 5 (2000 ms) for rank 2,
19 (2500 ms) for ranks 3 to 9 and 14 (3000 ms) for every Heartseeking Bolt rank. Owner ruling O-22 exempts the Witch Hunter family
from the 500 ms ranged preparation of SpellInfo::CalcCastTime, as Artificer's Wand and the Tinker shots are, and the client patch
stream no longer publishes a cast-time row for Darkslayer, so the client's own rows and the server agree. The server cast times
include Auto Shot 75's +15% ranged attack speed (O-21, D-127): Unit::ModSpellCastTime multiplies a ranged spell's cast by the
ranged attack speed factor 100 / 115 and truncates to int32. Barbarian Throw Weapon 804136 (family 18, CastingTimeIndex 5,
2000 ms) is the control: it keeps the preparation and its streamed 2500 ms row. Stock Hunter Steady Shot 34120 is not registered
